> This template is for maintaining the public generic workflow base. Adapt the inherited .github templates and repository guidance before using them in a downstream product repository. The upstream public-content restrictions always apply here.

## Objective

What base-level problem does this change solve?

## Scope and applicability

Which owners and files change? Which review checks below apply to this change?

## Evidence and claim boundary

List public or synthetic sources and separate Verified, Inferred, and Unknown claims.

## Verification

- [ ] If Markdown changed, review the changed rendering, links, anchors, and navigation.
- [ ] If scripts or workflow changed, run the applicable checks owned by .github/workflows/framework-checks.yml; state any NOT_RUN result.
- [ ] For a release candidate, complete the required one-time whole-repository tracked-Markdown links and anchors QA.
- [ ] Review public privacy, secrets, attribution, and the applicable license scope.

## Public-safety affirmation

- [ ] This public change contains no credentials, personal paths, account/workspace/customer identifiers, raw conversations, Memory, private project data, or private audit material.
- [ ] Examples and test fixtures are synthetic or safely public.

## Residual risk

What remains unverified or experimental?
